messages.subject: Google Analytics tracking code
parts:
Hello-

I've been trying to get google analytics working somewhat as per the documentation and not having success so far..

Here's what my shiny-server.conf file looks like:

server {
listen 8102;

location /happydays {
app_dir /srv/shiny/www/happydays;
google_analytics_id UA-XXXXXX-X;
}
}

My question is, according to the docs it says that the google_analytics_id can be a member of location as I have it above, but when attempting to have GA access the app (I can see GA coming through if I have access logging turned on) it appears that whatever tracking code needs to be there is not being displayed.

I'm sure I'm probably doing something wrong, do I need to modify the apps's ui.R file to get analytics to work or am I going about this totally backwards..

Thanks,
C

messages.author: 2b2736921b464c6e
messages.subject: Re: Google Analytics tracking code
parts:
Hello there, I have got GA tracking my Shiny app, by using Google Tag Manager to deploy the code:
https://www.google.com/tagmanager/

Code in ui.R:


#remember to escape the quotes - GTM-XXX is your GTM tracking code - copy from GTM setup
GTM <- "<!-- Google Tag Manager -->
<noscript><iframe src=\"//www.googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-XXXX\"
height=\"0\" width=\"0\" style=\"display:none;visibility:hidden\"></iframe></noscript>
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;j.src=
'//www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);
})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-XXXX');</script>
<!-- End Google Tag Manager -->

#output in ui.R somewhere
div(id="GTM", HTML(GTM))

I then activated Universal Analytics (the new one) in its normal template in GTM, using the UA code from my Google Analytics account.

This is working on port 3838, as verified in the GA realtime reports.

Hope that helps,
Mark

messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: Re: Google Analytics tracking code
parts:
I didn't use any built-in GA features if there were any.  I just used tags$head(tags$script()) and put two things in it:

Track a page view.  Not so useful since shiny is ajax-like and url doesn't change.

(function(i,s,o,g,r,a,m){i['GoogleAnalyticsObject']=r;i[r]=i[r]||function(){
        (i[r].q=i[r].q||[]).push(arguments)},i[r].l=1*new Date();a=s.createElement(o),
        m=s.getElementsByTagName(o)[0];a.async=1;a.src=g;m.parentNode.insertBefore(a,m)
        })(window,document,'script','//www.google-analytics.com/analytics.js','ga');
ga('create', 'UA-XXXXXXX-XX',...)
ga('send', 'pageview');

Track an event (e.g., user uploads file, changes selectInput, etc)

    $(document).on('change','#client',function(evt) {
      ga('send', 'event', 'Setup', 'Set Name', $(this).val());
    });


This setup is working wonderfully for tracking what users are doing on the app.

messages.author: 2b2736921b464c6e
messages.subject: Re: Google Analytics tracking code
parts:
I generally put a defintion of Google Tag Manager (http://www.google.com/tagmanager/)  in global.R, then write that out as HTML where I want it in ui.R.  This way you can alter the tracking using the GTM interface without changing the code in Shiny again.

So in global.R I have something like this:
GTM <- "<!-- Google Tag Manager -->
<noscript><iframe src=\"//www.googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-XXXXX\"

height=\"0\" width=\"0\" style=\"display:none;visibility:hidden\"></iframe></noscript>
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;j.src=
'//www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);
})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-PCVW');</script>
<!-- End Google Tag Manager -->"

...the GTM container tag as defined by the GTM interface.

Then add to where you want it in ui.R by:

    div(id="GTM", HTML(GTM))

Then login to GTM and activate Universal Analytics, event listeners etc.

Hope that helps,

On Tuesday, November 5, 2013 5:06:21 AM UTC-5, Mark Edmondson wrote:
I generally put a defintion of Google Tag Manager (http://www.google.com/tagmanager/)  in global.R, then write that out as HTML where I want it in ui.R.  This way you can alter the tracking using the GTM interface without changing the code in Shiny again.

So in global.R I have something like this:

GTM <- "<!-- Google Tag Manager -->
<noscript><iframe src=\"//www.googletagmanager.com/ns.html?id=GTM-XXXXX\"
height=\"0\" width=\"0\" style=\"display:none;visibility:hidden\"></iframe></noscript>
<script>(function(w,d,s,l,i){w[l]=w[l]||[];w[l].push({'gtm.start':
new Date().getTime(),event:'gtm.js'});var f=d.getElementsByTagName(s)[0],
j=d.createElement(s),dl=l!='dataLayer'?'&l='+l:'';j.async=true;j.src=
'//www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id='+i+dl;f.parentNode.insertBefore(j,f);
})(window,document,'script','dataLayer','GTM-PCVW');</script>
<!-- End Google Tag Manager -->"

...the GTM container tag as defined by the GTM interface.

Then add to where you want it in ui.R by:

    div(id="GTM", HTML(GTM))

Then login to GTM and activate Universal Analytics, event listeners etc.

Hope that helps,
Mark
